A criterion containing `<id>` survives a rewrite byte-for-byte
fix: Encode in rewriteItemJSON as publishNewItem does (SetEscapeHTML(false), two-space indent, trailing newline), update TestUpdateItemJSON_ErrorArmsAndCommitTmp's expected bytes, and drop runtime-reference's 'compare fields, not lines' caveats.

summary: lifecycle.rewriteItemJSON (behind UpdateItemJSON, RouteLane, and now evolve inbox edit and verify) writes json.Marshal of the field map: one line, sorted keys, and <, >, & escaped as \u003c/\u003e/\u0026. evolve inbox add writes two-space-indented JSON without HTML escaping (publishNewItem). A one-field curation therefore rewrites every line of a filed item and turns `<id>` in its criteria into `\u003cid\u003e` (verified 2026-10-01 on a copy of cli-inbox-edit), so the data PR a curation lands cannot be reviewed by diff.
title: The inbox item writer keeps the filed format, so a curation or route stamp is a one-line diff (lane part)
